purpose: Implementation and measured follow-up of the six whole-library audit projects.

changes: Compiled query source slots and rare-component occupied-word traversal
Despawn clears current registered component payloads
Explicit ecs.compact remaps current and previous columns; caller migrates references and invalidates caches
implementations.limit: Ordinary U32 entity IDs are not silently recycled; retained worlds and previous-step snapshots still retain their payloads.

changes: Generic immutable open-addressed map/frozen
Persistent 64-way radix pages, bounded copied paths, page batches and shared leaf scans
implementations.limit: Frozen maps have no persistent edit API; radix paths add constant costs to some small collections.

changes: Persistent chunk buffer and ECS command batches
Bulk sound/UI publishing
Direct single-message writes and amortized large reads
Single-output handle encoding
Scalar indexing followed by profile row construction, including partial packet recovery
Prepared polyline distance/yaw tables and binary search
Sparse budget-bounded A* workspace
Cached unit-grid classification
implementations.limit: No shared mutable scratch; cumulative F32 rounding can differ from path.along near segment boundaries.

changes: Reusable CSR graph, reachability queue and stable Kahn waves
Physics wake propagation without a fixed 32-pass limit
Recipe closure and schedule waves reuse graph algorithms
Stable quantile selection with bounded sorting fallback
Fresh exact-array slice/concat ownership
Mutually exclusive branch writes keep ownership
Native and executed-Wasm alias/snapshot regression coverage
implementations.limit: Development checks pass; full LLVM release qualification remains pending. An unrelated assertion reproduces on unpatched parent HEAD.

breakingChanges: Pages representation changed; use accessors, leaves or fold instead of direct page-table fields.
Command buffers expose commands.count/values instead of a values field.
Grid includes cached units classification; construct it through navigation.grid.
Despawn changes component revisions as it clears current payloads.
Compaction changes IDs and requires caller reference migration.
Recipe ties choose the smallest ready source index.
measurementLimits: Library before/after runs use the same copied installed compiler and native runner. Baseline library is a2710c4; timing passes were sequential, not interleaved.
Fixture construction, guest calls and result decoding are timed. Compilation, warmup, validation and ownership-counter sampling are excluded.
The full implementation pass covers 217 workloads; later targeted runs cover changed page traversal/construction and repeat suspect controls. Each comparison names its raw run.
Noise affected some initial unchanged controls: radial compiled to byte-identical Wasm; targeted math/transform/sampling controls returned close to baseline. Small ratios are not speed guarantees.
Committed guest memory is arena capacity, not live payload size, allocated bytes or host RSS.
Prepared-path figures include 4096 queries of a 1024-point straight path; they do not predict gains for short or infrequently reused paths.
Generic frozen-map results are separate from the faster restricted U32 prototype; the library preserves arbitrary key policies and duplicate replacement semantics.

Compiler ownership runs use a development binary with additional parent work. Their within-binary controls and allocation counts demonstrate the optimized paths; timing is not an isolated release before/after claim.
These are library microbenchmarks, not measured gdev frame-time improvements.
